title: Pager cache-size, spill-size, and shrink delegation

scope.rationale: The Pager forwards signed cache-size and spill-size configuration to PCache and delegates memory shrinking to the same cache owner, returning PCache's effective spill threshold.

external_source_responsibilities: PCache implements signed page/byte conversion, effective spill threshold, and shrink policy
dependencies.caller_closure: All three complete Pager delegation helpers are assigned on the production PCache owner and consume the source-faithful middleware methods.

inputs: Pager-owned Cache and signed cache/spill request
outputs: No value for cache size/shrink; effective spill threshold for spill configuration
contracts.ownership: Cache is borrowed and retains all pages and configuration.
contracts.state_and_results: Cache request is forwarded exactly. Nonzero spill request updates the threshold; zero queries it. Shrink frees all currently unpinned purgeable pages possible.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: PCache acquires its PGroup synchronization. No Pager I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible at the Pager boundary; cache pressure may leave pinned/dirty pages resident.

representation_differences: Zig methods live on the Pager-owned Cache rather than accepting a separate Pager wrapper pointer. shrinkPagerCache returns the removed-page count for internal observation although the C Pager API discards it.

oracle.protocol: Set a signed cache size, set/query the spill size, populate unpinned pages, shrink, and compare resulting limits/page ownership.
oracle.normalization: The extra Zig shrink count is ignored when comparing the void source boundary.

assurance.oom: No allocation at delegation boundary; PCache allocation behavior is separately covered.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; PCache PGroup synchronization is retained.
assurance.malformed_input: Signed negative byte-mode and zero query semantics are delegated to PCache.
assurance.continuation: Configuration and shrink leave the cache usable.
assurance.performance: Configuration is bounded by cache enforcement; shrink is linear in removable pages.

integration.native_call_path: Pager/B-tree configuration owners use the same Cache state that production page fetch, spill, and release paths consume.

independent_review.notes: Requires Pager-boundary differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C Pager forwarding trace over signed and zero requests.

implementation_spans: src/core/page_cache.zig Cache configuration, spill, shrink, PGroup ownership, and tests were reviewed
assertions_branches_cleanup: The generated spill return block is assigned; the void one-line wrappers generate no branch blocks
Shrink does not retire pinned or dirty ownership
upstream_tests: Upstream pager, pcache, cache-size, cache-spill, release-memory, and OOM tests cover these delegations
Project PCache and pager differentials cover limits, stress, and purge state
